title: What Does the Bible Say About Smoking? 24 Verses
description: Is smoking a sin? The Bible never mentions tobacco. What it says about the body as a temple, self-control and being mastered by anything, with 24 verses.
keywords: what does the bible say about smoking
bible verses about your body being a temple
summary: The Bible never mentions tobacco, cigarettes or vaping. The word tobacco is absent from both the World English Bible and the King James Version, and the word smoking appears in only 4 verses of the WEB, all describing a furnace, a mountain, torches and a flax wick (Genesis 15:17, Exodus 20:18, Isaiah 7:4, Matthew 12:20). So the question is answered from principles, and several are direct: the body is the temple of the Holy Spirit and belongs to God (1 Corinthians 6:19-20), believers are not to be mastered by anything (1 Corinthians 6:12), and whatever they do, they are to do for God's glory (1 Corinthians 10:31). Many Christians conclude that smoking harms the body and enslaves, and others leave it to conscience. The verses below are the ones that apply.

faqs.a: The Bible does not say so by name, since tobacco was unknown in the ancient Near East. Christians who say it is a sin point to 1 Corinthians 6:19-20 (the body is God's temple) and to addiction as a form of being mastered (1 Corinthians 6:12). Others treat it as a matter of conscience and wisdom (Romans 14:23). Almost all agree that a believer who wants to quit has Scripture and prayer on his side.

faqs.q: What does the Bible say about the body being a temple?
faqs.a: Paul tells the Corinthians that their body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, who is in them and whom they have from God, and that they are not their own but were bought with a price (1 Corinthians 6:19-20). He applies it first to sexual sin and the principle reaches to how believers treat their bodies generally.

faqs.q: Does the Bible say anything about addiction?
faqs.a: It does not use the word, but it speaks of being enslaved. Paul says all things are lawful but not all are profitable, and he will not be mastered by anything (1 Corinthians 6:12), and Jesus says everyone who sins is a slave to sin and the Son sets free (John 8:34-36). Galatians 5:1 says it is for freedom that Christ has set us free.

faqs.q: Can God help me quit smoking?
faqs.a: The Bible promises strength for a believer who is struggling: God provides a way out of every temptation (1 Corinthians 10:13), his power is made perfect in weakness (2 Corinthians 12:9), and we can do all things through Christ who strengthens us (Philippians 4:13). Practical help, such as a doctor, a quitline or a support group, works alongside prayer.
